name: Gambling Den
author: Oddisz
description: A back-room gambling den at every port of size 6 or more. Sell surplus hulls for tokens. Slots is the first game, with more games planned: choose one to five reels and stake 1, 2, 4 or 8 tokens per reel. Most reels bust; wins pay credits, tokens, weapon crates and hull mod boxes. A large hull mod box holds ten blueprints by default and skips hull mods you already know. Crate sizes and odds have LunaLib sliders.
